shortDescription: NetApp E-Series discover E-Series storage systems

options.name: ports
options.description: This option specifies which ports to be tested during the discovery process. The first usable port will be used in the returned API url.

options.name: prefer_embedded
options.description: Give preference to Web Services Embedded when an option exists for both Web Services Proxy and Embedded. Web Services Proxy will be utilized when available by default.

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: Web Services Proxy REST API URL. Example https://192.168.1.100:8443/devmgr/v2/

options.name: proxy_validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate Web Service Proxy SSL certificate

options.name: subnet_mask
options.description: This is the IPv4 search range for discovering E-Series storage arrays. IPv4 subnet mask specified in CIDR form. Example 192.168.1.0/24 would search the range 192.168.1.0 to 192.168.1.255. Be sure to include all management paths in the search range.
